name: Shebaniah
overview: Shebaniah appears in Scripture as a faithful servant of God who served both as a priest during King David's reign and as a Levite actively involved in covenant renewal during Nehemiah's leadership. In 1 Chronicles 15:24, he is listed among the priests who participated in worship before the ark of God, demonstrating his role in temple service. Later, in Nehemiah 9 and 10, Shebaniah is mentioned multiple times among the Levites and priests who led the people in prayer, praise, and covenant commitment, highlighting his dedication to God's covenant and the spiritual restoration of Israel.
